# Concept: Spaced Repetition

## Statement

Spaced repetition is a learning technique that schedules reviews of information at increasing intervals to maximise long-term retention.

## Context

The core idea is that memory decays over time following the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve.
By reviewing information just before it is forgotten, retention is reinforced efficiently.
Anki is the most widely used spaced repetition software, using a flashcard model.
Alex uses spaced repetition for language vocabulary and technical concepts.
